source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Distillation Process, printed as 15.2.1 with Figures 15.6 and 15.7, pages 328-329.

blocks.text: Simple distillation solution se solvent alag karti hai. 100 cm3 samandari pani lein aur apparatus lagayein (print ki Figure 15.5), liquid ke uchhalne (bumping) se bachne ke liye chand boiling chips dalte hue aur apparatus ko hawa-band karte hue taake bukharat na niklein. Flask ko Bunsen burner se halka garam karein aur condenser ke gird thanda pani aahista ghoomne dein. Pani (ya alcohol) apna boiling point aane par bhaap banta hai, us ke bukharat condenser se guzarte hain, aur ghoomta pani unhen wapas liquid mein condense karta hai: distillate, jo receiving flask mein jama hota hai. Distillation flask mein bache ajza mil kar residue hain.

Do milne wale liquids ko is tarah alag karna fractional distillation hai, jo sirf tab kamyab hai jab boiling points taqreeban 25 degrees C mukhtalif hon. Distillation column, sheeshe ka column jo bukharat condense karne ki satah barhane ke liye sheeshe ke moti (glass beads) se bhara hai, mixture ko boiling point ke mutabiq ajza mein alag karta hai (Figure 15.7). Jab ethyl alcohol aur pani ka mixture garam kiya jaye to alcohol pehle distil hoti hai kyunke us ka boiling point, 78 degrees C, pani ke 100 degrees C se kam hai; jab tak alcohol distil hoti hai thermometer 78 degrees C par rehta hai. Jaise hi darja hararat 78 degrees C se oopar barhne lage receiving flask naya laga diya jata hai; jab thermometer 100 degrees C tak pohnche to pani ubalta hai aur condense ho kar doosre distillate ke taur par jama hota hai, to dono ajza khalis milte hain (Figure 15.6). Qudrati petroleum fuels ke taur par istemal hone wale bohat se compounds ka mixture hai, jaise petrol, diesel, kerosene aur furnace oil, jin ke boiling points bohat mukhtalif nahi; yeh fractionating column mein fractional distillation se fractions ke taur par alag kiye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: burner par distilling flask jis par moti bhara fractionating column, oopar thermometer, dhalwan pani se thanda condenser aur receiving flask, labels ke saath. Oopar daen: waqt ke muqable thermometer reading ka graph jis mein ethanol distil hote waqt 78 degrees C par hamwar hissa aur pani distil hote waqt 100 degrees C par ooncha hamwar hissa hai. Neeche daen: simple ke muqable fractional distillation aur istilahein.
blocks.caption: Simple aur fractional distillation ka apparatus aur ethanol-pani ka darja hararat record (Figures 15.6 aur 15.7 aur topics 15.3 aur 15.2.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Liquid boiling chips wale flask mein ubala jata hai, bukharat thermometer ke paas se bahte pani se thande condenser mein uthte hain, aur condensed distillate receiver mein tapakta hai jabke ghair-udne wala residue flask mein rehta hai. Do milne wale liquids ke liye sheeshe ke motiyon se bhara column lagaya jata hai, jo bohat si satahein deta hai jin par bukharat condense aur dobara ubalte hain, to kam ubalne wala liquid pehle oopar pohnchta hai. Ethanol aur pani ke saath thermometer ethanol guzarte waqt 78 degrees C par rukta hai, phir sirf pani bachne par 100 degrees C tak charhta hai, aur darja hararat barhne lagte hi receiver badla jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Fractionating column ka kya kaam hai, aur dono liquids ke boiling points taqreeban 25 degrees C mukhtalif kyun hone chahiye (exercise Q.2e; MCQ VII, VIII)?
blocks.explanation: Sheeshe ke moti bari satah dete hain jis par uthte bukharat bar bar condense aur dobara bhaap bante hain; har cycle bukharat ko zyada udne wale juz se bharpoor karta hai, to sirf kam ubalne wala liquid oopar aur condenser tak pohnchta hai. Agar boiling points bohat qareeb hon to bukharat mein dono liquids itne zyada hote hain ke saada column unhen alag nahi kar sakta aur distillate mixture hota hai.

items: Simple distillation: boiling chips, hawa-band apparatus, halki garmi, pani se thanda condenser; distillate jama, residue rukta hai. Fractional: sheeshe ke motiyon wala column; ethanol 78 degrees C par distil (thermometer theher-ta hai), darja hararat barhne par receiver badlein, pani 100 degrees C par; petroleum fractions.
